title: G1b fix round 1: cli._scorecard_text_rows lambda arity breaks test_scorecard_by_goal_text_has_waste_and_turns (gate red on T-0265)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 3ca3c46 "Add goal token scorecard metrics" (T-0265) in git log; never drop it.
Gate on T-0265: tests/test_cli.py::test_scorecard_by_goal_text_has_waste_and_turns errors with 'TypeError: Cli._scorecard_text_rows.<locals>.<lambda>() takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given'. Fix the lambda (or the call) in orchestrator/cli.py so the goal table renders every row, including rows without gate data ('-' cells), with the new columns total_tokens, uncached, cache_read, output, jev, planner and the footer 'tokens per accepted goal: N over K goals (usd M)'. Run tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_scorecard.py, then the full gate. If any other cli test pins the pre-G1b goal header, update it to the new header and say so in the final message; do not change scorecard.py.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 3ca3c46 below your commit
uv run orchestrator scorecard --by goal prints the T-0240 row with the new columns and the footer line
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

result.summary: Codex (luna) committed b215d1e on top of 3ca3c46 (T-0265) in wt/T-0291: cli goal-table row lambda fixed; test_scorecard_by_goal_text_has_waste_and_turns, test_scorecard_goal_footer and the default-output snapshot pass. On this repo `scorecard --by goal` prints T-0240 with total_tokens 6,629,573, uncached 5,178,200, cache_read 9,490,038, output 147,208, and the footer 'tokens per accepted goal: 5963247 over 9 goals (usd 20.27)'. Planner note for the retrospective: cache_read exceeding total_tokens on T-0240 means legacy rows (pre-G1a token formula) and normalised rows are mixed; a polish task should make total_tokens consistent for old rows. tests-green.sh wt/T-0291 exited 0 (Planner). Carries G1b. Posted by hand.
